tabs.title: Sidebar sections
tabs.body: The sidebar has five sections: Recent, My notes, Groups, Shared with me, and Trash. They show icons only; hover over one to see its name. Deleted notes go to the Trash first.
tabs.narrowBody: The sidebar has five sections: Recent, My notes, Groups, Shared with me, and Trash. Deleted notes go to the Trash first. Open the sidebar from here.

newNote.title: New note
newNote.body: Click here to create a note. It goes into My notes.
newNote.narrowBody: "New note" at the bottom of the sidebar creates a note in My notes. Open the sidebar from here.

folders.title: Folders
folders.body: Use this button in the My notes header to create a folder. A note's ⋮ menu has "Move to…" for putting it into a folder.
folders.narrowBody: You can create folders from the My notes header. A note's ⋮ menu has "Move to…" for putting it into a folder. Open the sidebar from here.

search.title: Search
search.body: Press {{mod}}K to search. It finds titles and note text.
search.narrowBody: Press {{mod}}K to open the sidebar with the search box focused. It finds titles and note text. You can also open the sidebar from here.

header.title: Share and more
header.body: "Share" invites others to view or edit. The ⋮ menu has "Present", "AI edit history", "Move to…", and "Copy to…".

versions.title: Version history
versions.body: Notes save versions automatically by default, and you can press {{mod}}S to save one yourself. Open the version history with this button in the bottom-right corner.
versions.narrowBody: Notes save versions automatically by default, and you can press {{mod}}S to save one yourself. The version history is in the ⋮ menu.

wikilink.title: Link to another note
wikilink.body: Type [[ anywhere in a note and pick another note to link to it. The note you link to lists this one under "Mentioned in".

ai.title: Ask AI about a selection
ai.body: Select text and press the AI button in the toolbar that appears to have AI work on it. A sentence is already selected for you here.

slash.title: Insert blocks with /
slash.body: Type / to insert headings, lists, tables, diagrams and more, like the flowchart in this note. For side-by-side columns, pick "2 columns" (up to 4), or drag the ⋮⋮ beside a block to the left or right edge of another block. Drag the divider between columns to resize them.

userMenu.title: Forgot how something works?
userMenu.body: Press {{mod}}/ or open Help from here: shortcuts, the feature tour and what's new are all there, any time.
userMenu.narrowBody: Press {{mod}}/ or open Help from the menu at the bottom-left of the sidebar: shortcuts, the feature tour and what's new are all there, any time. Open the sidebar from here.
